company.description:
The world’s most advanced vehicle tracking dongle. It fits most cars manufactured since 1996 and is available in the UAE and other countries from Saudi Arabia to USA. dashroad is a hardware and software solution to help you get more value from your car.


By giving car owners the tools to get insight on how their driving effects not just society in general and their own bottom line, they hope to change the driving behavior of millions.


It is a simple but ambitious goal that has been founded in Dubai by a couple of car guys who have a combined 15 years of car design experience from making some of the safest mass produced cars to the most insane ones (Rally cars).


Dashroad is a Platform-as-a-Service company that focuses on bringing out the data from cars to help build a platform of connected car applications. Simply put, we are going to make car owners money based on their driving data.
